attributes.name: Mentu-Nebef
attributes.powers:
All damage dealt by Mentu-Nebef is Poison damage.

Before you act, search your location deck. If you find a non-villain monster, Mentu-Nebef is evaded.

If defeated, draw the loot Cartouche of Protection from the box, then you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.
